_comment: 私有包清单模板 / Private package inventory template. 复制到技能根目录并改名为 private-packages.json。只写你确实私有的名字；写错会造成误报。/ Copy to the skill root as private-packages.json. List only names you actually own privately; a wrong entry causes false positives.
_why: dependency confusion 需要两件事同时为真：名字是你的，且同名包在公开 registry 上可被他人发布并被优先解析。清单提供第一件；第二件必须联网核对，扫描器不做，也不该假装做了。/ Dependency confusion needs both: the name is yours, and a same-named package can be published publicly and resolved first. This file supplies the first; the second requires a registry lookup, which the scanner does not do and must not pretend to do.

_format.names: 不带 scope 的裸包名（PyPI 与 npm 通用）/ bare package names, both ecosystems
_format.scopes: 你拥有的 npm scope，形如 @org / npm scopes you own, e.g. @org
